about.title: Needles Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Needles sits at the edge of California where Interstate 40, Route 95 and Needles Highway carry a steady mix of local drivers, long-haul trucks and travelers passing through. In 2025 the city recorded 16 injury collisions and 22 people hurt, with no traffic deaths that year, but a wrongful death claim is not limited to the roadway. Families here also lose loved ones to workplace accidents, unsafe property, medical mistakes and defective products. Under California law, a wrongful death case is a civil action that stands apart from any criminal charges. It allows a spouse or domestic partner, children, and in some situations other dependents or heirs to recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it can be much shorter when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Needles families with an independent attorney, free of charge, so you can focus on grieving while someone else handles the paperwork.

whyChoose.title: Why Needles Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity About Who Can File
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death claim, starting with the spouse or domestic partner and children, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out standing quickly so the right family members are protected.

items.title: Deadlines Tracked From Day One
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and cases against a city, county or state agency face a far shorter window. Early connection with counsel helps keep those dates from slipping by.

items.title: Every Category of Loss Considered
items.desc: Funeral and burial expenses, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance are all recoverable in California. Network attorneys work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My family member died in a crash on I-40 near Needles but we live in Arizona. Can we still bring a claim?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death that occurs in Needles is generally governed by California law and handled in San Bernardino County courts, regardless of where the surviving family lives. Out-of-state families often coordinate with a California attorney remotely, and LawProactive can connect you with one at no charge.

items.question: Do we have to wait for the criminal case to finish before filing?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil matter and proceeds separately from any criminal prosecution. The civil case uses a different standard of proof and can move forward even if no charges are filed. Waiting can put the two-year deadline at risk, so it helps to speak with an attorney early.

items.question: What if a government agency may be responsible, such as a road maintained by the state or county?
items.answer: Claims against public entities in California follow a different process with a much shorter deadline, often measured in months rather than years. A formal claim usually must be presented to the agency before a lawsuit can be filed. An attorney can identify whether an agency is involved and act within that window.
